name: messaging
description: Post messages to a team chat workspace (Slack/Teams-style). No read access to existing channel history by design — a chat plugin doesn't need to read what humans said to post a message on the agent's own behalf.

tools.name: post_message
tools.description: Post a message to a named channel.

tools.name: post_direct_message
tools.description: Post a direct message to a single named user. Kept as a separate tool (not just 'channel' accepting a user ID) so a permission or hook can distinguish broadcasting to a channel from messaging one specific person.
